definitions.explanation: A day off granted to an employee as compensation for having worked on a regular day off or holiday.

examples.japanese: {代休|だいきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I'll take a compensatory day off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{代休|だいきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Since I worked on Saturday, I got a compensatory day off on Monday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{代休|だいきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I'm so busy that I can't manage to use up my compensatory days off.

notes: Common collocations include {代休|だいきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take a comp day), {代休|だいきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to be given a comp day), and {代休|だいきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to use up comp days). Legally distinct from ⟦{振替休日|ふりかえきゅうじつ}→振替休日：15073_furikaekyuujitsu⟧ (transferred holiday), which is scheduled in advance before working on a day off. {代休|だいきゅう} is granted after the fact, usually at a later date chosen by the employee or employer.
